description: Older calculator kept for backwards compatibility: maintenance (Mifflin-St Jeor × named activity level) times 0.80, 0.85, 1.00 or 1.10 by goal. It has no Bodywise page. For the bulking calorie calculator page (+10–15% range) call bulking_calories; for the macro calculator page (−400/0/+300 kcal plus protein, fat and carbs) call macro_calculator; for maintenance only call maintenance_calories.
name: calorie_calculator
title: Goal calorie target by percentage (legacy)
